message: XVatsim 2.0.1 is available. Download the freeware Windows XP12 package from X-Plane.org or GitHub Releases.
release_notes: Reduces settled X-Plane flight-loop workload while preserving immediate full refreshes for meaningful operational changes.
Retains a one-second safety refresh while unchanged callbacks use the lightweight settled path.
Avoids repeated inactive vNAS work outside the supported United States scope and unnecessary diagnostic job formatting.
Preserves the accepted controller-selection, information ORB, Standby Assist, and UI behavior.
